punchline: Chamberlain had one meeting, one signature and his own impression; Czechoslovakia was not in the room.
thirty_sec: After meeting Hitler at Berchtesgaden on 15 September 1938, Chamberlain wrote to his sister that here was a man who could be relied upon when he had given his word. After Munich he returned with a signed paper and said "I believe it is peace for our time"; on 15 March 1939 German forces seized all of Czechoslovakia.
question: Whose promise are you relying on mainly because of how a recent conversation felt?
key_contrast: Not the feeling of the meeting, the record of what the person has done.
